thread:
claire.design: Quick design question — CTA hierarchy in Trace viewer. claire.design: Current layout puts [Export trace] as primary and a tiny copy icon for correlation id. I think Copy is the more common action. raj.product: +1. Copy corr id is the one product teams use for linking between systems. Export is heavier, used less frequently. sam.eng: From infra side: export kicks off a job and can take 10–30s depending on trace size. If we make Export primary, we should show async progress states. claire.design: Right — thought was to foreground the fastest/most used action. Proposal: Primary -> Copy corr id (text button), Secondary -> Export (dropdown with CSV/JSON). morgan.pm: Use metrics — last 30 days: copy action ~4x export. So data supports copy-first. aria.a11y: A few a11y nits if we reorder: the correlation "pill" must be keyboard focusable and have an ARIA label, e.g. aria-label="Correlation ID 1234, click to copy". Also announce copy success with aria-live="polite". sam.eng: We can add a visually-hidden region for announcements. Implementation suggestion: ```
``` aria.a11y: +1. Also ensure when the pill receives focus it exposes the full id, not an ellipsis, to screen readers. claire.design: Good catch. For keyboard ordering — should the Copy pill come before the trace-level actions? My thought: left-to-right: Copy | Export ▼ | More. raj.product: That ordering makes sense. Also can we make the Copy button slightly larger for touch? Many folks copy on tablets. sam.eng: Fine. I'll update styles, but note we should avoid moving DOM order purely for visual reasons — keep DOM order matching logical action order for SR. morgan.pm: For Export dropdown, include a short description on each format (CSV = flattened, JSON = full). People get confused. claire.design: Agreed — small helper text under the menu. Also thinking about keyboard shortcuts: `c` to copy corr id when trace modal focused. Thoughts? aria.a11y: If we add shortcuts, ensure there is an accessible hint (e.g., press ? for shortcuts) and that they don't conflict with global app keys. Also document in release notes. raj.product: Can we update the export flow to be non-blocking? maybe show immediate toast "Export queued — we will email when ready" for huge traces. sam.eng: We can. Backend already supports async jobs. I'll add a quick job-status endpoint and a small polling UI. claire.design: I'll mock new layout and states (idle, copying, export queued, export ready) and include screen-reader copy messages. claire.design: Mock snippet for copy confirmation we can use: ``` // after copy const srToast = document.getElementById('sr-toast'); srToast.textContent = 'Correlation ID 1234 copied to clipboard'; ``` aria.a11y: Perfect. Also ensure the copy button has `aria-pressed` transiently while copying for assistive tech. morgan.pm: Small analytics ask — add event names: `trace.copy_corr_id`, `trace.export_requested`, `trace.export_ready`. Helps us track adoption. sam.eng: will emit events. export_ready should include file_size and format. claire.design: One more: export button placement on small screens — should be inside the overflow menu to avoid crowding. raj.product: Yes, on <480px, collapse into kebab menu. claire.design: I pushed a quick screenshot to the thread: https://redwood.slack-imgs.com/T1/mock/trace-cta-v2.png deploy-bot: snapshot uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/trace-cta-v2.png aria.a11y: Preview looks good. Two last checks: color contrast for the Copy chip (need 4.5:1 if it’s a text button) and focus outline visible. claire.design: I'll update colors and add 2px focus ring per guidelines. morgan.pm: schedule this for next sprint? we can prioritize after a/b test for CTA ordering. raj.product: yep — canary rollout for 5% then 25 then 100. monitor `trace.copy_corr_id` and error rates on export job. claire.design: Thanks team — will post updated mock + spec with keyboard flows and SR announcements later today. :raised_hands:
